title: Fig and the Big Pot
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, ow, oi, ear added, 47-sound stage.

pages.brief: Fig the green caterpillar standing inside an old wooden barn, hay bales stacked around.
A large clay pot sitting on top of a wooden cart inside the barn.
Fig the caterpillar pushing against the big clay pot, straining, the pot not moving.
Fig the caterpillar bracing with all his legs against the pot, still unable to move it.
Fig the caterpillar calling out loudly from beside the cart.
Ned the duckling arriving through the barn doorway, walking towards Fig.
Ned the duckling and Fig the caterpillar pushing together, the big clay pot starting to turn on its side.
Fig the caterpillar and Ned the duckling sitting together beside the cart, the pot now tipped safely on its side.
